A new leak reveals that one of Apple Watch's most popular watch faces — Modular — will receive several new color customization options in watchOS 27. Details below.

Modular watch face to gain new color customization options in watchOS 27

Apple plans to expand Modular watch face customization options in watchOS 27.

Modular has become a favorite among many users thanks to its flexibility. It can display multiple complications and also customize the face's appearance with different color options.

Aaron Perris discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 shows watchOS 27 will add nine new color options to Modular.

This beta version does not yet have previews of these nine new colors. However, Perris found their names in the beta code.

Some of the new colors are likely previews for new bands launching next month alongside the Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Additionally, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple will release a brand new Modular watch face in watchOS 27, inspired by Modular Ultra.

Which watch face do you use most? Feel free to share in the comments.
